data.one_liner: Utility functions for the mocktail library to increase productivity in tests.
data.what_it_does: Adds extension methods to mocktail stubbing objects, allowing concise syntax for answers, returns, streams, and ordered mock sequences. It acts as a wrapper so mocktail does not need to be imported separately.
use_when: You are already using mocktail for testing and want to reduce boilerplate when stubbing methods.
You need to easily stub sequential return values or answers using thenReturnInOrder or thenAnswerInOrder.
avoid_when: You do not use the mocktail library in your test suite.
You prefer using standard mocktail syntax without additional wrappers.
strengths: Reduces boilerplate code for common stubbing patterns like void functions and streams.
Provides convenient ordered return and answer sequences.
Exports mocktail so you do not need to import both packages.
weaknesses: Dependent on the mocktail package and its version updates.
Very narrow scope focused only on syntax sugar for mocktail.
data.setup_notes: Add mocktailx to your dev_dependencies and import package:mocktailx/mocktailx.dart in your test files.
